verdict.rationale: decK is documented as an APIOps tool for declarative, version-controllable Kong Gateway/Konnect configuration (kong-docs-4, kong-docs-67), and Kong's databaseless/declarative deployment model (kong-gh-4) implies config-as-code that can be diffed and reapplied to effect a rollback. However, this covers gateway/API configuration rather than 'automations' in a broader agentic sense, and there's no explicit documentation of a built-in review/approval workflow or a dedicated rollback command. Missing for 10: explicit rollback tooling/commands, a documented review/approval process, and independent/hands-on evidence of version-and-rollback workflows in practice.
